title: Creative Intent Contract (contractVersion 1)
description: Machine-readable form of the Creative Intent Contract (Program CG, CG6/CG7). Describes one exported Creative Intent instance for an approved creative from the Creatives Generation system. Carries INTENT ONLY — no presentation (color/material/environment/layout), no internal anti-sameness bookkeeping, no governance/approval state. Existence of a conformant instance implies its source creative was approved=yes at export time; that fact is never itself a field. This schema expresses structural and semantic (enum) validation only — digest and trust validation require logic outside this document.

id.description: Stable identity — the creative's slug. Unique across every Creative Intent instance a given producer has ever emitted (cross-instance rule; not enforceable by this schema alone).

contractVersion.description: Contract major version. Must be in the reader's own supported set.

digest.description: sha256 content-address over {contractVersion, id, belief, feature, ratio, camera, must-include, content-provenance, section?}, canonical form (sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, section omitted if absent). Recomputation mismatch is fatal.

provenance.description: Opaque, audit-only metadata. Carried verbatim; never interpreted by any conformant reader. Excluded from the digest.

belief.description: The one sentence the creative makes the viewer believe. Captured verbatim at generation time. Immutable once first emitted for this id (a trust-layer rule, not schema-checkable).

feature.description: The Feature Mapping capability row this creative argues. The primary classification key.

ratio.description: The creative's aspect ratio, asked at intake and held exact.

camera.description: The semantic framing distance chosen to prove the belief.

must-include.description: Verbatim hard content requirements from intake. Always present as an array; empty when none were declared. Never reconstructed after the fact.

content-provenance.description: Whether every data point in the creative traces to the original intake spec (human) or the generator invented content to fill a gap (augmented). Decided once, at generation time.

section.description: Intended placement, when known at intake. Never guessed retroactively — absent means unknown, not 'no preference'.

$comment: additionalProperties is true at the top level so an unrecognized key never fails schema validation (forward-compatibility) — a conformant reader implementation SHOULD still warn on it, per the specification's error model (CG7 §7). additionalProperties is deliberately NOT relaxed inside any enum property: an unrecognized enum VALUE is always a fatal structural error, never a warning, because it breaks that field's own closed vocabulary rather than merely adding an unread extra.
